name: reverse-skill
description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients
one_liner: A toolkit that gives AI coding assistants a routed set of skills for reverse engineering and authorized penetration testing, so the AI pulls in the right specialized tool automatically instead of you hunting for it.
buyer: A boutique security research or authorized-penetration-testing firm that wants its analysts to move faster using AI-assisted tooling on engagements they're already contracted to do.
business_use_cases: A pentesting firm equips analysts' AI coding assistants with this skill router so routine reverse-engineering steps on authorized engagements go faster.
A security research lab uses the self-evolving knowledge base to capture and reuse findings across similar authorized assessments.
A CTF training company packages it into a paid workshop teaching students how to combine AI assistants with reverse-engineering workflows.

money_ideas.idea: Paid training or workshop teaching security professionals to use AI-assisted reverse engineering responsibly.
A premium, curated skill pack sold to security firms as an add-on to the free open-source router.

steal_this: This is a niche tool for people already doing authorized security work, not a general weekend business idea. Skip it unless you're already in that field.
